Only one caution, and Q'uo gives it plainly. Do not do this work hastily, without respect, without preparation. Begin with meditation. Begin with the balancing of the energy system, the clearing of the lower energy centers to the higher, so that the energy doing this work is without significant imbalance. Shadows that block energy into the heart will keep energy from reaching the centers where this work takes place.

The question was how to apply this to a daily life. And I think the answer is hiding in the word Q'uo keeps returning to. Thirst. Come empty. Come royal and naked. Reach, and let the fruit drop into your open hands.

Thank you for listening.

title: Love Into the Void
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: Love Into the Void.

This session is from the first of April, two thousand and one, and it carries an unusual note. The group had called for Q'uo, but Hatonn came instead. Hatonn tells the group that it is the nature of this particular question that brought forth his energy. Hatonn is of the love vibration, he says, and truly there are some concerns that are addressed through the totally open heart rather than through wisdom. I find that honest. Some questions need love, not cleverness.

The question is this. What is the most harmonious way to achieve closure in a relationship when the person you are trying to close with will not talk to you? And when you feel a strong emotion in desiring to close, is there anything you can do internally, by yourself, that does not involve the other person?

Hatonn begins with forgiveness. It may not seem that closure has much to do with forgiveness, he says, but in actuality it has a great deal to do with this somewhat difficult concept. The relationships that come into a life are a gift of the self to the self. Before incarnation, we give ourselves targeted issues we wish to explore, and we give ourselves relationships by whose means these issues may be addressed most efficiently.

Ideally, he says, relationships are experienced as the coming together of two entities who work with more and more harmony until all the learning between them has been accomplished. But on the level of the physical illusion it often seems that the expression of a relationship is sadly incomplete and must be left in what seems to be an inharmonious condition. The other person may have passed from this physical illusion, ending the direct chance of communication. There may be such separation from circumstances and differences of opinion that there is no longer the opportunity to communicate. Emotions can come between two entities, making it impossible for them to speak with each other, whether from anger and guilt or simple misunderstanding.

Hatonn is gentle here about our divided nature. The spirit within incarnation is a mixed being. On one hand there is the personality, which wishes to be comfortable and to manipulate and control situations for comfort and safety. On the other there is the completely spiritual being, which has little to do with time and space but has a great deal to do with ideals and inspirations and mystery and, oddly enough, ethics. And that awakened part of us at all times wishes to do everything possible to create the most ethically pure situation, where all respect has been given, all communication harmonized, all differences healed as well as words can heal them.

But when the other entity has simply decided to end a relationship without communication, Hatonn suggests that the first work is simply to release the situation from your conscious control. Then, spiritually speaking, it is perfectly possible, and he highly recommends it, to pursue closure until the heart within the self is completely satisfied. There are no issues of infringing on free will here, for it is your own free will that is involved, and you can decide what you wish to do.

And then Hatonn gives a practice, a physical action. Write down all those things you wish to say, one after the other, in exquisite detail, leaving out nothing. Then take the letter and either burn it, ritually and carefully, offering it up to the infinite Creator, or wrap it around a piece of tree root or a rock or a small pebble and bury it, with ritual words expressing the willingness to release the situation from human control and judgment. If there is no desire for further relationship, burn. If there is a willingness to do the work again in some future where such issues may be worked upon, bury. But in both cases, ask the self: how can I make the most loving and most harmonious end? How can I release this soul to move along its path with the most open heart?

I love that Hatonn does not pretend this is easy, or that we are strong enough to always manage it. Remember, he says, that you deal with fragile, fragile beings when you come into relationship. It may seem you are fighting a tremendously powerful force, yet you are only fighting yourself. The other, just like you, is a delicate, sensitive, vulnerable spirit, often confused, often out of control.

And he closes with the heart of it all. Realize in a very deep way, he says, that the job of the self is to give and receive love. The work of loving is endless, for it does not take the agreement of another person to love that person. All beings may be loved without infringement of free will. So work on loving without expectation of return, without attachment to the outcome of a letter or a telephone call. Love into the void, into the abyss, he says. That is a life lived in faith.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Cycles of Seeking
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: The Cycles of Seeking.

The question put to Q'uo on the sixth of May, two thousand and one, is one that every honest seeker has lived through. A seeker begins with passion. Then the passion fades. The material that once burned bright goes quiet. Is this failure? Is it time to move on? What does a seeker do with the cooling of the heart?

Q'uo answers with a story that is, as they say, always the same. It is a story about love. When you are in a passionate stage of seeking, your heart is on fire with that which is love. The Creator loves each and every spark and atom of creation with a love beyond all that can be imagined, and this love is the spark within the heart of each of the Creator's children.

Each of you, Q'uo says, is made of that same Thought that is the Creator and the created. And each of you, having received this infinite gift of life and spirit and being, has created through the winding trail of experiences many, many shadows and variations on that original Thought of Love, so that each of you vibrates in love, and yet with many unique characteristics of your own, which mark each of you with a signature which is unmistakable. We would know each of you in any density, they say, and in any form of body you would take, for each of your souls is unique.

The instrument that day had said there is only one truth, there is nothing new under the sun, and Q'uo agrees. Our story is too simple to be told in an understandable fashion, they say. We work through channels such as this one because each channel has a personality and an attitude which enrich our simple story with words and images, finding new ways to share our hearts. And this is what the thousand thousand entities inspired with the love of the Creator offer. Some have been codified as holy works. Some never wrote their words down at all.

I love how Q'uo puts the cycles in context. Within the incarnational cycle there are numerous cycles. The day revolves light and dark. The year brings warmth and chill. Each cell of the body is renewed every so many years. And so it is natural, indeed natural, that even the most devoted student of the very best story would find, after a certain period of time, that the self is full and sated with that story. There is enough of that source within the being.

This does not necessarily mean it is time to move on. Q'uo speaks of walking through the desert of unbelief, walking through the difficult and bleak times when there is no spontaneous inspiration, and says it has its own very powerful effect upon faith. Those who choose a religious or philosophical path as a life path are wise to remain upon that path in good times and in bad.

But there are many who cannot resonate with one story, one religion, one philosophy, and they will make their own paths. These are entities that may well find themselves moving in and out of devotion to several or even many different sources of inspiration as the path moves through the years. Q'uo does not recommend one way over another. For those who find their food from this and then another and then another source, they simply commend all that is old and all that is new.

And here is the part I want to linger on. Even if the seeker sticks with one body of material, she will be cycling through it into another period of her own learning each time she reads. So she comes to that material as a new person, and spiritual words are never actually old. It may seem that you are moving backwards, regressing. But even were you to move back into that same material and be kindled anew, it would not be coming back to the same material. It would be looking at it with new eyes, finding a new level of learning and inspiration within those pages.

Because the truth the seeker seeks lies beyond the words. Truth cannot be written down. Truth lies within the heart. Within essence. Whatever study you move into is not bringing you to truth, Q'uo says, but rather bringing you to a place from which you can begin to think about truth in a way that resonates to you.

And so the question: is it a good idea to attempt to be on fire for the Creator all of the time? No, Q'uo says. It is not a surface passion that is to be encouraged as a steady state. Instead, experience as truly and really as possible what is being felt at each moment. You are not attempting to deny your experience. The comfort, the joy, the bliss of companionship with the Creator is not out there somewhere, but within the heart, that same heart that beats so strongly within the body.

Teachers are everywhere, Q'uo says. The frog upon the rock, the iris blooming in the garden, the raven out the window. All the familiar images of this particular day are divine as well as mundane. Be on the alert for those resonances, those special words, those special images that bring the Creator alive to you.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Refining Fire
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: The Refining Fire.

The twentieth of May, two thousand and one. The question to Q'uo is about the process of growth itself. What happens within a seeker as growth occurs? Why is it that we may feel the repercussions internally long before anything shows in the outer life? And how does one survive the process with some degree of comfort?

Q'uo begins with an image. They rest within each vibration in the circle and see each person as a flower, each with its own scent and shape, each blossom at a different stage of unfolding. Some personalities with more thorns than others, some hardier plants than others, but all blooming beautifully according to each soul's nature. And then this reassurance: nothing can truly harm this process. Maturation and evolution are protected processes. They cannot, in fact, be halted, not for long. The mills of destiny grind fine, and that which has been rough has been refined.

There is a certain amount of maturation that occurs because of the outer events of a life. But the question was directed, Q'uo notes, at the inner landscape. There is a level at which the feeling associated with outer events percolates and distills during the refining process. No matter how large or small the outer events, what they bring up for the seeking soul is the attention-getter that pulls the focus away from the literal and mundane details into those areas of sensitive feeling and fragile vulnerability that seem to limn the treasure box of the unconscious.

And here is the irony. The more material that catalyst offers, the less articulate the words become that will satisfactorily encompass the feelings and the processes of suffering that take place during the burning. When there is a large and obvious catalyst, an illness, a death, a change in employment, others can grasp it without effort. But when the difficulties arise from tender feelings, from the inner winces and shudders that accompany difficult experiences, it is far more difficult to frame a simple conversation and describe what is going on.

So what does Q'uo recommend? Not probing, pressing, and exploring, though that has its bittersweet pleasantness. Something more skillful. Simply accept the feelings that are sweeping through the energetic being. The great trick of the intellectual mind is to consider itself capable of understanding situations, and for outer situations it often can. But when it comes to fear and the desire to be comforted in the processes of growing spiritually, it is more helpful to move into that portion of the being which has no words. For those feelings do not need words in order to move through the various filters of each chakra, working like the energetic brooms that they are, cleaning, purifying, moving through the system like weather.

I love that image. Begin to see yourself as a far sturdier being than you feel yourself to be. See yourself as much a solid being as a planet or a star. See yourself as a fantastically complex flower that blooms in good weather and bad, and that enjoys both the rain and the sun in their seasons. When the flower experiences the rain, it simply accepts the rain. When the sun shines, it gratefully accepts the sunshine. Both are necessary for the health and the evolution of this bloom.

Q'uo will not pretend the suffering is not suffering. We would be fools to try to tell you that you have not suffered, they say. Each of you has undergone great difficulty. What they are saying is that this suffering is a tremendously helpful force, offering those refining energies that you came to experience. Not because you wanted to suffer, but because you wanted to investigate and see if you could remake, with even more purity, that choice to serve the light with which you came into this incarnation.

For what the instrument calls the Holy Spirit, what many call guidance, what those known as Ra have called the higher self, took counsel with you before this incarnation. With great thought and care you chose those people that are in your life: mates, parents, children, friends and enemies, each carefully positioned to rub against you this way and that and knock off the sharp edges. Each is as the refining fire to those around them, and those around them are as the refining fire to them. And yet the fire is not of the person, but of the spirit.

What is encouraged, then, is a mixture of high ideals and utter down-to-earth practicality. Trust that the soil in which you were planted is the correct one for your best growth at this time. Realize the permanent in the ever-changing world of your heart. If you dwell in the mind and think many thoughts and skitter across the surface of ideas, you may make a great noise but not a great deal of sense. If you move into the silence and reality of the heart, you may say nothing, but you will be resting in the peace that lies within the precinct of that heart.

And the one most powerful method of enhancing the processes of evolution? Meditation. The habit of silence, Q'uo says, is helpful profoundly and continuingly. It is the single most attainable way of moving from the level of the outer world into the levels of that inner world where the feelings and the processes of being revolve.

We hope you find many moments of peace, Q'uo closes. But we assure each that the unrest and the disquiet have a purpose too.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Work of Passion
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: The Work of Passion.

The twenty-ninth of August, two thousand and one. A special meditation, with questions from the one known as R. And the questions are deeply human ones. There is a pattern in my work, R says. I criticize myself because my work should be more service-to-others oriented. Then I find a new kind of work that has energy in it, that grabs me, and then the energy fades. What is this pattern? How do I explore it?

Q'uo answers that the challenge of right occupation is not the challenge it seems to be on the surface. The concept of occupation has been distorted by the needs of peoples for money. But there is a subtler distortion, and Q'uo names it carefully. It is easy to see the materialism of the world and its ways. It is less easy to see how that materialism may have penetrated into areas of the metaphysical, and caused elements of the work ethic to become elements of spiritual materialism.

Spiritual materialism. The very drive to be of service can carry the world's own measuring mind into it. The rules and the ways of the world and the spirit are genuinely, from the core outward, different, Q'uo says. And so R is asked to sift out those elements which have to do with the world and its ways, in order to see the real form beneath: the skeleton, the muscles and sinews that underlie the flesh of spiritual seeking.

For there is a structure to right occupation in the spiritual sense, and it has to do with those things that are of worth in the spirit rather than in the world, in the heart rather than in the mind, in the intuition and the resonances of feeling rather than in the logic and reason that characterize intellection.

One thing Q'uo suggests: review the gifts which have been brought through into the personality shell available in this incarnation, and ask how best these gifts might be shared. The job, the career, is connected more with money than with the gifts one shares. Whereas activity that can be chosen of oneself, like volunteering time and attention in certain ways, offers a far more elastic form of inquiry. Interaction with another self, while often very confusing, contains within it a tremendous potential for learning. Suppositions confined in the privacy of one's thoughts cannot be examined with the same efficiency as when they are placed cheek by jowl with actual experience.

And then, through the second instrument, this addition. Investigate any area in which one finds excitement, interest, passion. A desire to serve increased by the pleasure of serving. For there are truly no mistakes. All entities are the Creator. One can only serve the Creator. All expenditures of energy are a service to the one Creator.

And here is the line I want to hold up to the light. Passion is a kind of a pre-incarnative gift. It is a continuance of that which has previously opened one's heart, which again finds resonance in the present incarnation by the expression of a passionate desire to be of service in a certain manner. In this way the lessening of excitement which R has observed in his patterns may be ameliorated, and the most full expression of the heart's desire to serve might be achieved wherever passion is found.

R's second question turns to a pattern of looking for a mated relationship, finding one, and then the relationship ending soon after. Is there a spiritual structure to such a relationship? Are expectations blocking the flow of passion and true love?

The mated relationship, Q'uo says, is a specific kind of service. An experience of mutual desire for seeking the one Creator, for serving the one Creator, and for sharing the life pattern out of which seeking and service are born. The words about occupation apply here too. The need to love and to be loved is as natural a function of the human being as sleeping, eating, breathing. And although each can seek and serve in a solitary fashion, the yoke of such honor and duty is more easily borne when shared.

But expectations held strictly or dearly can become an obstacle. And then this, which I find startling and true. One cannot approach that which is a consuming fire, that which changes the life, that to which one must surrender at one level, as if it were hiring someone to fill a position. One can choose a mate, but one shall get what one has chosen. The product of rational thought may or may not be that emblem of love which speaks to one's own whole self. There needs to be something within the choice that cannot be denied, that is felt passionately to be sufficient cause of the discomfort, suffering and pain of surrender to a relationship. For any relationship will set into motion the wheels of transformation in such a way that they are never under your control in any substantial sense.

The face of the Creator is seen through that person. And that entity, too, will be challenged to so love you as the face of the Creator that she can see more of the Creator in herself because she has you as her mirror.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Lucid Dream
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: The Lucid Dream.

The second of September, two thousand and one. The question to Q'uo is about the state of the planet: the wars, the diseases, the famines, the crises that occur on a daily basis. Is there a gain or a decrease in love upon planet Earth? Q'uo answers it in two parts, and both are worth hearing in full.

First, the surface. As the one known as R had said, the surface of life has a spurious and shallow reality that is nonetheless undeniable. It is a world of complete illusion, and in that world, Q'uo says, the dragon thrashes its tail. And angels in flesh quiver, defend, worry, and hope to respond in ways that add love to the illusion. A little positive, a little negative, and the illusion wags on, doing the job it was meant to do: thoroughly confusing, baffling, and frustrating. All efforts of the linear and conscious intellect to control it bring each inevitably, if each is honest, to the realization that the self knows nothing. That the life of the surface has nothing. That all is, in the words of the instrument's Bible, vanity and striving after wind.

Such is the surface of life. Such is the design intended for that illusion. And then Q'uo turns to what the physical eyes cannot see. There is tremendous growth in the metaphysical sense among the peoples of the planet. It is abundantly, richly clear on the metaphysical planes that a tremendous outpouring of love and concern has streamed into the Earth plane. Many Earth native individuals, those who have been within the planetary influence as souls since pre-history, have come through the many waters of many, many incarnations over thousands of years, and have slowly but surely come to the point where the alarm clock has gone off. The awakening of the spirit within flesh has taken place. And these voices have become a great choir asking and seeking and knocking at the door of truth.

And many entities, Q'uo says, have chosen to travel to the earth plane from other planetary influences, plunging the self into the third-density atmosphere once again, in hopes of serving the planet and its people, but also in hopes of doing work upon the self. A reevaluating of that all-important choice of third density: the choice of whether to love by radiation and unconditional love, or to love by control and magnetic attraction, and the overriding sense that people need to be managed for their own good.

Now comes the practical question. How does one become the self most truly and most deeply? Q'uo still seeks the answer themselves, which I find moving. But they offer this. One great goal of each incarnation is to become aware that you are dreaming, and to make the dream of incarnation a lucid and a conscious dream. One that is, in some ways and to some extent, a matter of your choices.

The interesting thing about personality, Q'uo says, is that each of you chose both your gifts and your limitations, your abundances and your lacks, for very good reasons. The challenge is to come into some fuller realization of the pattern behind them. What was hoped for by the higher self when you and your higher self planned the plot points of this incarnation? Why did you put that blockage there? That remarkable gift there? In each connection there is a fullness of goodness, if one can but see the plan. Though one seldom sees the plan until the pattern is complete and one has the blessed advantage of hindsight.

Most often the spiritual riches are found when life is at its darkest and most challenging, Q'uo says. For it is then that the little hammers and chisels and acid water etch and smooth and craft and find the gems within the ore that is the personality shell. And yet, at the same time, advances are often made in blinding steps forward that seem like the dawning of a sudden sunrise, the turning of a corner which opens into a new world.

Be prepared for sudden and stupendous moments of awareness, Q'uo says. Because you are a being. You are not an activity or a process. And you surprise yourself being yourself sometimes. In those moments when you have hit a resonance that strikes deep into the self, the moment opens up and you become aware of all that you are, of the tremendous unity you have with everything that is.

You seem to stand upon the Earth, sticking out into space, upon this ball revolving around a minor sun at the edge of a rather small galaxy. And yet you are standing upon holy ground. You have to remember that you are the product of the Creator's thirst for knowing Itself, and your seeking to know yourself is part of the Creator's seeking for Its own identity.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Lightning-Struck Tower
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: The Lightning-Struck Tower.

The sixteenth of September, two thousand and one. Five days after the attacks in the United States. The group asks Q'uo for a point of view on the events taking place in the earth world at this time. If you are carrying grief from that time, or from any loss, please be gentle with yourself, and reach out to someone you trust or to real-world support if the weight feels heavy.

Q'uo begins by acknowledging the suffering, and a particular kind of suffering which is not only the suffering of one nation but which goes into the overriding ethos of the culture. And yet, alongside the genuine suffering they see in the finer planes, they also report a tremendous outpouring of love, light and energy.

To give their point of view, Q'uo asks us to move from the physical to the realm of concepts. For in the metaphysical creation which is the counterpart of the physical creation, concepts are that which is real, and form is a matter of choice. In that creation, ideals are geography. And one system for studying this creation of concepts is the system of the twenty-two archetypal images which predated the tarot deck as used for divination.

One of these images is called, in the system offered by those of Ra, the Tower, or the Lightning-Struck Tower. And it is at this level of meaning that Q'uo looks at the planetary situation. The planet as an entity, and each of you as part of the human family of Earth, is moving through a tremendously transformative period. Not in terms of physical transformation, though that is to some extent likely. In the metaphysical aspect of intense transformation, as the planet changes densities, changes the very nature of its core particles, changes the nature of its light.

It has been transforming for approximately two thousand of your years, Q'uo says, accelerating markedly for the last two hundred, and profoundly accelerating in exponentially shorter amounts of time as the cusp is reached. In this climate of change, the Earth is as vulnerable as a pregnant mother giving birth to a child. It has been given an unending amount of negative emotional catalyst by those attempting to polarize toward service-to-self, and by the careless actions of those not attempting to polarize in either direction, who occasionally create suffering almost casually.

The thoughts entities have habitually thought over a long period of time have created difficulties in the health of the entity Earth, which the instrument is fond of calling Gaia. And here Q'uo says something plain and hard. Your people and Gaia desperately need to be loved. To be seen. To be apprehended for the first time as part of the self.

Q'uo will not give specific predictions, for the future is not fixed. It is liquid. It is a creature of thought, and it will be the fruit of the seeds you are planting now. All of you are sparks of one flame, they say. You may choose at this time a direction of how to think, and they encourage us to focus the mind, the heart and the commitment upon love.

Then they return to the Tower. Within your next decade or two, this transformation will have taken place. This is the time to acknowledge fully the need to learn the ways of the self, to become more familiar with the thoughts of the heart, to accentuate the tendency towards positivity, compassion, tolerance, creativity, hope and faith.

And here is the teaching I want to carry with me. In this system the Matrix of the Spirit is called the Devil, and the Lightning-Struck Tower is the Potentiator of the Spirit. Those who bring light have always had a bad reputation, Q'uo says. Lucifer is one of the names used for the Devil in your culture, and the roots of the word mean light-bringer. The teaching is about the value of wisdom in spiritual seeking within third density. Knowledge and wisdom, in the spiritual sense, can be seen to be highly negative when unlit, unillumined, by love. That is why love is learned before wisdom. That is why love must be learned before wisdom. For when wisdom is learned first it is smooth within the intellectual digestion, and so handy in the display of personality, that it is often not clear, for lifetimes at a time, that without love, wisdom is utterly devoid of content.

The Lightning-Struck Tower is a signal that great catalyst is now available for the spirit. In this system the Catalyst of the Spirit is Hope. You could also call this entity Faith. Honing the faculties of faith, hope and love will be an agenda that will keep you profitably busy for the rest of your incarnation, doing what you came to do, serving as you came to serve.

You are now those who bear a kind of light to Earth, Q'uo says. In a way, you are Lucifer now. But you are not evil, nor was Lucifer intending toward evil. Much in this story is mis-told. Archetypically speaking, Q'uo sees our situation as far more blessed and hopeful, because in the last ten, twenty, thirty years they see an acceleration of the light on this planet as well as an acceleration of the dark. And to them, it is very clear that the forces of light are gaining strength.

In the words Q'uo borrows from the Holy Bible: let not your heart be moved. In quietness and in confidence shall be your strength.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Light-Bringer
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: The Light-Bringer.

The twenty-third of September, two thousand and one. The group returns to the archetypes, this time the Matrix of the Spirit and the Potentiator of the Spirit. They ask Q'uo about the light-bringer, whether it is Lucifer that was the light-bringer, or Eve who gave Adam the apple from the Tree of the Knowledge of Good and Evil. What follows is one of the most far-reaching sessions in this part of the archive.

In the system of images which the Confederation has often discussed with this group, the archetypes are divided into three groups: those pertaining to the body, those pertaining to the mind, and those pertaining to the spirit. In each there is a matrix, a still and unmoving structure that is a receptor web. What it can do is desire. It can reach. And in each there is a potentiator, that which fertilizes or makes fruitful the matrix. In the spirit, Q'uo says, the dynamic is this: the unreaching, unhasting darkness of spirit waiting for, hoping for, yearning for, desiring information about itself. And out of that dark yearning comes the Potentiator of the Spirit, which is light.

Let us take a moment, Q'uo says, to gaze at the power and the peace of this situation. The spirit, the soul, the entity that each of you is, is a crystalline shape, a snowflake, a beautiful crystal. Each of you is unique. Each of you has your own symmetry. And within your crystal each of you is working with those perceived flaws, those clinging barnacles of matter that are not the gem.

Then this line: the kingdom of the spirit is a dark one. Not because darkness is evil, for darkness is not evil. But because it is the nature of spirit within third density to be largely impossible to see. It is dark because it must be dark. And the light that is the Lightning-Struck Tower, though it may seem radiant when seen as a symbol in the destruction of the towers in New York, in terms of metaphysics it is a frail and flickering candle of a lightning bolt that is all too quickly extinguished, and shows all too little of the hidden landscape of the spirit.

Each of us will spend the incarnation peering into darkness using seemingly the dimmest of lights, occasionally receiving that bolt of epiphany that speaks, that is as the star that guides, that brings that moment of clarity and spiritual truth that is so blessed. And the Matrix of the Spirit is called, in the tarot system, the Devil, simply because the spirit seems, in its form, to be antithetical to the body. It seems there is a tremendous sacrifice involved in moving from things of the body to things of the spirit. When light has been brought to the spirit there is tremendous change and transformation, and there is a death process that goes on as the allegiance of the seeker moves from one kingdom to another.

Is this an evil matrix? Is there something evil about the spirit that has brought the energy of Lucifer and Satan into identification with it? Q'uo answers without hesitation. No. Absolutely without hesitation there is no evil whatever in the spirit, nor is there good. But rather there is simply essence. There is that which is.

Those who bring light, Q'uo says, are a way of saying those who bring polarity. It is not precisely knowledge that the tree in the Garden of Eden story was bearing. It is not simply a body of knowledge that was forbidden. Rather, it is the essence of third density that is being talked about in this story. The creatures of Eden were basically second-density entities. They did not have free will. They did not have self-awareness. The story of the one known as Satan offering the fruit of good and evil to the one known as Eve is, as one in the group points out, a delightful way of shifting the blame for the entire fall of human nature to women. And that incorrect solution has entranced and delighted men in many religious systems, leading many into sweeping generalizations concerning the unworthiness of the feminine gender.

Each within this circle is fully aware, Q'uo says, that this is not a correct solution. It is neither a masculine nor a feminine quality, good and evil. The reason behind the woman giving to the man this fruit, this polarity, this third-density essence, is simply that in the system of archetypes the Matrix of the Mind is the unfed seeker, and the Potentiator of the Mind is a deeply feminine character, the High Priestess, the fructifying influence of the subconscious. This is the only reason for the attribution of so-called evil to the feminine character. It is well, when looking at stories such as this, to look at them in symbolic terms, in terms that provoke contemplation of deeper issues.

The darkness of the spirit is like unto the darkness of the starry heavens, Q'uo says. That thick velvet of infinite space is as you are in your spiritual aspect: an undiscovered country of hills and valleys unknown. And every place is sacred. And every place is full of information. And every place looks to be that which it is not.

Even when the veil of forgetting is lifted, even in densities full of light, still that spirit is stubbornly unknown, and layers of misinformation will fall away as the densities roll. The Creator, Q'uo says, finds out about Itself from you, each of you.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Temple and the Priest
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: The Temple and the Priest.

The seventh of October, two thousand and one. The group asks Q'uo about the healing meditations recommended a couple of weeks earlier, in response to the September attacks and to the many places on the planet full of anger and war and hatred, famine, poverty and disease. How can ordinary people be instruments for the love and the light of the Creator?

Q'uo calls this a most central and key question, for them as well as for us. They too are focused on how to offer love and light to the planet and its peoples. But before techniques, Q'uo speaks about the room where all technique begins. The sanctuary.

This communication of ours is bound in silence, Q'uo says. It is silence that fuels the channel, silence that fuels the desire of those present, silence that enables that desire to be honed. It is silence that enables the self to be known to itself. It is in silence that trust and faith abound. It is in the shared silence of prayer that miracles happen.

Prayer is a word with emotional overtones for many, and Q'uo uses it broadly. Not only formal words beseeching the Almighty, but prayer as entering the silence, prayer as practicing the presence of the one infinite Creator. It is easy to open an empty room by silence. It is more fruitful to realize that room within as a room that has atmosphere and person, as the sanctuary in the very heart of the temple that the priest may enter for private moments. Those moments fuel the ministry that serves others.

For each of you is a temple, Q'uo says, and a priest within the temple. The temple is that body and that personality and those gifts. The priest is the consciousness within that directs that building and its stewardship, the disposition of the talents and treasures of the temple. Each priest needs to spend time in that sanctuary that has to do with no one but the self and that connection that is sacred between the self and the infinite Creator. Between the loved and the lover. Between the spark and the source of that spark.

It is helpful, Q'uo suggests, to picture entering not an empty room of impersonal prayer but a very personal room, the heart of self, in which there waits the figure of the Creator as the Creator would appear to you. Many see the Creator as Father. Many see the Creator as Mother. Some see the Creator as the Christ, as does this instrument. Whatever that image is, realize that the Creator is waiting for you there, and that you go to be with your true self when you enter the sanctuary of silence.

This lines up the energy body so that the silence may be offered and may be used for the Creator. And Q'uo makes a point I want to underline. It matters not the perceived degree of efficacy achieved by the meditator or the one who prays. What matters is that the entity remember. That the entity come into remembrance of that sanctuary, that infinite Creator, that presence that touches the life and in so touching the life creates the life for it.

Then the most courageous act. The greatest and most courageous feat of faith, Q'uo says, is a surrender to that spirit and to that spirit's will for you. And that in itself is a prayer. Send me forth. Create me. Play on me as you play on the face of the deep and create that which is a new world, that which is a new me. Let me be, for the first time, fully my true self. And let that true self become full enough of the higher aspect of self that it irresistibly begins to radiate.

As for the practical work of sending light, Q'uo says each of you is a crystal instrument. And truly it is not necessary to know precisely how you are creating the melody of love, how you are shaping that crystal being so that it can transmute, intensify and anchor the infinite light and love into the planetary vibration. It is only necessary to surrender to the intention. In terms of the metaphysical, the clumsy and awkward attempts of sincere people are far more persuasive than the sophisticated, easily spoken and roundly shaped phrases of faith that do not come from the heart. It is not necessary to be clever or articulate or even to have words.

And the secret to visualization? Find an image that brings forth the passion and the desire to serve and opens the heart. Perhaps the simplest image is the globe itself. The instrument's book cover shows the globe with the sun rising behind it, the dawn of the new age breaking over the Earth. Or picture oneself as one of many beings weaving a net of love and light, like a fisherman's seine or a butterfly net, that wraps around the planet like a great full skirt from an angel, so that all of the planet is wrapped in this shining mesh made of individuals' love and light, woven energy upon energy.

Or if visualization is difficult, simply speak to the Earth. Give words to the Earth. Explain how much it is loved by you, how much you appreciate it, how much you want to help it come through this tremendously exhausting and difficult period of birth. One great problem, Q'uo says, is simply convincing your planet that you truly care. The sheer passion and persistence of this effort is what the Earth will hear.

Thank you for listening.

title: Fear Is a Creature of Love
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: Fear Is a Creature of Love.

The twenty-first of October, two thousand and one. The question to Q'uo is about fear. Before September, people had the normal fears of having enough money, food, friendships, harmonious work. Now there is a general tenor of foreboding, a fear that there might be more attacks. What is fear, and what can be done with it? If fear or anxiety weighs on you as you listen, please be gentle with yourself, and turn to someone you trust or to real-world support when you need it.

The conversation before the meditation had brought up the question of how fear could possibly be love, Q'uo says, and perhaps that is where we shall start. If you tug at the string of fear from the end of its origin, it unravels far more easily than if you tug past the tangle-point in the present moment, where the fear is living.

So gaze at love itself. When Q'uo speaks of love, they are not speaking of the love of family or mates, nor even the love of brotherhood. They speak of that which is the essence of the Creator. Love, as they speak of it, is not simply an emotion, but an utterly coherent Thought. It is a Thought so powerful that it has created all that there is. This Logos which they call Love is an infinite concept. Indeed, one word for Love is intelligent infinity.

This creative Thought, by the action of free will, chose to create light. All that therein is, is made of light. All that is light was created by love. Consequently, all that is experienced in the creation is one thing, and that is love. No matter how distorted that energy, its substance is the same energy, the same ancestry as the lightest and brightest of energies. Each of you is a creature compounded of love, moving within an energy field that is made of love and shaped by your distortions of that love.

Then the energy body. Each center within the body is vulnerable to distortion in a particular way, and Q'uo uses the word distortion to indicate fear. For fear is a very common distortion of love. In the red ray, the energy is blocked by fear of survival. In the orange ray, in the lower belly, the energy can be blocked by difficulty in relationships. In the yellow ray, the solar plexus, the energy is blocked by fears of family, of society, of one's place within the larger groups. And a great deal of what many are experiencing in this autumn season, Q'uo says, has to do with the energies that became manifest on the eleventh of September. These are basically yellow-ray fears. The solar plexus of many, many entities within your culture has been punched hard, and given the opportunity to choose fear, not just once but many times.

When fear closes the energy that flows through the body, energy moving into the heart becomes less and less. The natural effect of allowing fear into the energy body in any settled way is to close the heart. One cannot hear when one is screaming, and in a way that is what fear does. It deafens the ears of the heart.

And yet this fear is a creature of love. And the patient seeker has resources to bring to bear. When one sees fire, one has a perfect right to fear the fire. It is hot. It will burn. Q'uo has no right to suggest that anyone not fear a terrorist attack. Yet in a non-linear sense, if one can move back in thought, beyond the present moment and the present catalyst, into the realm of personal essence and consciousness, the resources are powerful and ready to help.

In the beginning, dealing with fears, it may be necessary to move slowly, to allow the fear to be with you, uncomfortably so. Sitting with that, feeling that discomfort, creates a growing awareness of the nature of this fear. As the one known as R said, sitting at the campfire with this fear, sharing a story, enjoying the night together, allowing this situation within to be what it is, is a helpful beginning. One thing fear greatly needs, Q'uo says, is a lack of ridicule and an honest respect.

One energy prevalent in fear is the desire to control that which cannot be controlled. Almost never does one have control over the object of fear. It is precisely the inability to affect changes in something that has created the fear. And so Q'uo speaks of the leap of faith. Leaping into a void. Putting oneself in a situation where there is no control. The straightest road from fear to love is faith, they say. The ability to move beyond the tangle in the stream of energy, back to the source.

There is the classic description of fear from the Buddhist tradition. A seeker hanging onto a rapidly decaying branch on the side of a cliff, with a tiger above and a tiger below, and a chasm beneath. And the answer to that image is to let go of the branch, wave farewell to the tigers, and welcome the abyss. In faith, Q'uo says, there is the realization that in no way, shape or form can we know in a linear sense that all is well or that all will be well. And yet that is what we claim. That is what we believe. And on that we base our security and our confidence.

Thank you for listening.

title: A Nation of Priests
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: A Nation of Priests.

The fourth of November, two thousand and one. The group asks Q'uo about the souls who departed in the attacks of September, and whether their deaths might have been a catalyst for the rest of us. It is a question about grief and about meaning. If you are carrying grief for someone you have lost, in that time or in any time, please listen gently, and reach out to someone you trust or to real-world support if the sorrow feels too heavy to hold alone.

Q'uo begins with the season. It is the time of year when the celebration is made for those who have departed the physical incarnation in faith and are considered among the faithful departed. All Saints, in the instrument's church. The time when all of those who have experienced incarnation in this world and have moved on are remembered.

Your question has to do with how a death can be more than a death, Q'uo says. How a tragedy can be more than a tragedy. And not only is this so, but it is so again and again, in large occasions that acquire global notice, and in the very small tragedies that occur within the purview of one small life. And yet within that life is all of creation.

The nature of mortality, Q'uo says, is such that the incarnational experience as a whole can be seen as that which is sacrificed. The breath moves in and the breath moves out of the body just so many times, and then that body again becomes dust. The heart beats so many heartbeats, and then that heart is stilled. In those who have gained a great deal of peace there is no concern left when the question of dying is looked at. It is simply part of the future history of that body. It is no longer catalyst for distress.

The nature of destiny is such that the future is not fixed. What Q'uo can say is that you have made arrangements with a specific group of entities to be in the position of companion and minister to them, just as they are companion and minister to you. You have agreements set in place to look at certain incarnational questions. For most entities those questions have to do with the giving and receiving of love. For many these lessons revolve around how to serve, how to give freely without expectation of return, how to be a healing presence without infringing the aura of another.

And so, in a way, all of those souls whose lives ended on the eleventh of September had dates with destiny, and in another way they were completely free up until the moment that possibility turned into actuality. Each of you is a co-Creator, capable of generating tremendous light and love. Many there were who met their death that day in such a way as to embrace the light. Many there were that day who were as the unsung heroes whose stories shall never be known, who in helping others lost their own lives.

But this session is not only about the dead. It is about the living, and about what we do with what we have been given. The object of so-called terrorism is simply to instill terror, Q'uo says, to instill fear and discomfort in the minds of those who were formerly smug and uncaring of the rest of the world. And there is now a profound feeling of having been awakened from a sleep, a pleasant sleep that now is at an end.

The group had been given a quotation in the instrument's guidance. And ye shall be a nation of priests. Q'uo unfolds it like this. Think of the thoughts you have thought today, the concerns upon your mind, and then think of yourself as a priest, and ask: were I a priest, would I have been content with these thoughts, these actions? Would I have been content with my day, with my service, with my walk? Would I have felt that I had touched into the presence of the one infinite Creator?

The sense of it, Q'uo says, is that each of you is as a flower that is opening. There is a point at which the pilgrim soul can see itself not only as a student but also as a teacher. Not only as a member of the congregation, but as a minister. Not only as one who comes to the table asking to be fed, but as one who moves into the kitchen and makes sure that the feast is prepared.

When you seek, when you learn, you develop a responsibility to share what you know, to live what you know, to express what you know in your daily life. Perhaps it is nothing more than a smile. A positive reaction to a negative situation. A word dropped at the right time. At a time when it is easy to give negative thought, finding that one positive thought is to work magic.

When people realize their power they become much more effective. So Q'uo asks each of us to realize the tremendous potential within. Realize that you are already exerting a great deal of power, so the question becomes: what is the right use of power? Where is the love in the situation in front of your eyes? That is the question that brings the most resonance and affords the most magic in terms of being able to effect change.

Love one another, Q'uo closes. That is the heart of priesthood: to love, to bless, to witness to the light.

Thank you for listening.

title: Love Distorted
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: Love Distorted.

The eighteenth of November, two thousand and one. The question to Q'uo is as old as war itself. Why do human beings in third density, especially here on Earth, seem to be so war-like? The group mentions Mars, which was apparently so war-like that it destroyed its atmosphere, and Maldek, which exploded its planet. Why does this keep happening? And why do we fight against each other instead of with each other?

Q'uo says the causes are unified into one cause is the nature of the physical vehicle. When you gaze at the instincts of the stock from which your species developed, Q'uo says, you may see that your instincts are those of a territorial animal. The great apes occupy a certain area for hunting food and protecting their source of water, each group independent, each group with its own territory and its own way. This instinct basis feeds into the mind's working. Even though these instincts are unthinking, they represent a substantial bias that prejudices third-density entities in the direction of what is perceived as their territory or their possession.

Another thread is the nature of the third-density mind. Without the benefit of the consciousness that is you as an eternal being, this mind is a choice-maker mind. It is designed to make one choice after another. It assumes there is always a right choice, and sees the process of living as a sequence of choices. Faced with a situation, the first mental reflex is not to appreciate it, to understand it, or to plumb its subtleties. The first reflex is to solve it. To make it go away. The tendency to see black and white, yes and no, feeds into that ability to be belligerent which is indeed a hallmark of your density.

Another thread is the challenge of working with groups. The great question in any group is what is the character of that group? A group shows its character as it chooses its leaders. And those who attempt to be leaders within large groups tend to have personality structures in which the use of aggression seems fair, the use of influence just, the use of all advantages necessary. And a final thread: the tendency of the stronger to bully the weaker. Not only nations against nations, but as the one known as C pointed out, male against female, one kind of energy over against its dynamic opposite, instead of coming into cooperation with that dynamic opposite.

And Q'uo does not disparage war in and of itself. It is part of the almost inevitable confusion of third density. A case can be made for war as a game, they say, as an excellent game, rich in glory and honor. Like many things which from a wider point of view seem insane, going to war is part of the expression of third density as most third-density planets experience it.

But beyond all these threads, the heart of war and the heart of the reason for war is the nature of love. Listen to this carefully. All things that you experience come to you as distortions of love. There is no other substance but love from which to draw life. So all of life, including murder, pillage, and rape, is act after act of love: love distorted, love blocked, love asked to go where it would not go. Nevertheless, no matter how many times the stock seems to be hybridized and ruined, the basic root stock of all experience is love.

Third density is the density of choice. And the choice is not between love and hate, Q'uo says. The choice is between two ways of seeking love: loving others as a way of choosing to love, or loving the self as a way of choosing to love.

Needless to say, the service-to-others path is not a war-like path. And yet the struggle to see clearly the roots of love within the self is a tremendous one. It is not that anyone knows not how to love. There are very simple words to indicate the qualities of forgiveness, compassion and love. But all of these words are only within the mind until an energetic attempt begins to translate these ideals into that which can be manifested in physical life. So the question becomes: what is each seeker's response to the call of love?

And then Q'uo addresses peace directly, and it is not what you might expect. It is thought by some that if people would stop shooting at each other we would have peace. And yet it is not as simple as that. Like love itself, peace is beyond all condition. Peace does not originate within conditions. Peace is a quality that is waiting for each third-density entity to take it and claim it as their own, a wonderful, blessed possession.

Yet how many entities truly seek the peace within their own hearts which comes from stopping the striving and encouraging the resting in what is? How many truly embrace peace if peace involves releasing many other things which are dear? The instrument's Bible tells of the young man who kept all the commandments and asked what else he must do, and was told to sell all that he had and give to the poor. And he went away unhappy, because he did not wish to do this.

The answers are within the silence, Q'uo says, not within their words. But they are glad that each of us has the energy and the will for this great task of seeing the truth amidst the confusion.

Thank you for listening.

title: Walking the Golden Path
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: Walking the Golden Path.

The ninth of December, two thousand and one. The question from the one known as B is about the formation of a social memory complex. It is understood that this formation is crucial to fourth-density existence, and that the human race has been unable to even begin to form one. The question is: what portion of this preparation might be accomplished by seekers of truth simply seeking the truth and living a life? Is there something specific that we need to do?

Q'uo begins with a distinction. There is a quantum break between third density and fourth density. So the question cannot be answered as asked, precisely because third density is not fourth density. But there is an equally valid question hiding inside it: how to express fourth-density values within third density, thus foreshadowing the fourth-density reality. And that foreshadowing, Q'uo says, is a gift of hope.

When a third-density entity allows or surrenders to that ineffable energy of unconditional love, which has often been called Christ consciousness, then the experiencer of this love vibration is dwelling, unknown to herself oftentimes, in fourth density. That quality of love, when the veil is removed, simply places one in a fourth-density environment. In that environment the social memory complex is alive and well, because the nature of consciousness there allows that pattern.

But here is the part for us, in this life, in this body. Any time there is between two entities an energy exchange that is genuinely and authentically mutually loving, without reservation or purpose of control or manipulation, any time there is the achieving of a state of trust that is pure between two entities, any time there is that insight and awareness of the oneness of the self and another, within that moment, within that communion, however long it lasts, you are walking the bright and golden path of social memory formation.

I love that phrase. The bright and golden path of social memory formation. Weaving connections and experiences that redound not only to the personal process of evolution but to the planetary process of birth into fourth density. Third-density entities running fourth-density energy greatly aid in the formation of the fourth-density social memory complex simply by opening the heart to the extent that those moments are possible.

Q'uo adds one more thought that I find both comforting and true. They are glad to keep speaking on subjects that seem to cycle around and cover the same material, because at each asking the direction from which the question comes is different, not only horizontally but vertically. It is a matter of the cycles of questioning being spirals, and the learning of a spiritual principle is completely nonlinear. Some of the seemingly advanced bits will come very easily to a certain personality, whereas some of the most simple things will be very difficult. Consequently, it does no good to take one's own spiritual temperature. Simply continue to live each day as though it were the central concern of your soul to live it well.

So the answer to B's question is simpler than it looks. You do not need to build the fourth-density social memory complex while you are in third density. That is not the work of this life. The work is the foreshadowing. The work is the moments: two people, genuine love without reservation, trust that is pure, the awareness of oneness. In those moments you are already walking the golden path.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Forgiveness That Frees
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: The Forgiveness That Frees.

The twenty-third of December, two thousand and one. Two days before Christmas. The question from the ones known as B and S is a continuation of the inquiry about social memory complexes. Does such a complex possess a kind of consciousness that can exchange energy with its members? Or is it simply the sum of its members? Q'uo answers with the story of a man named Jehoshua, whom the instrument's culture calls Jesus.

The question is apt for the season, Q'uo says, for all over the world millions of hearts turn now to thoughts of peace, love and giving. Christmas itself is a response of the heart of a society to the maximum amount of darkness and the minimum amount of light. The lack of light creates a mood, and the tendency of that mood is toward poignancy and intensity. Life within third density is often, among other things, an accumulation of moments of pain that certain occasions bring closer to the surface of memory.

But the energy of Christmas has never been expressed precisely the way that Jesus expressed it. And the way this entity expressed it has to do with the question about the formation of a social memory complex. This entity, Q'uo says, was in his own way a politician. But he was a politician who was running for office in another world. As he said, my kingdom is not of this world. He identified his kingdom as the kingdom of heaven.

There has been a tremendous amount of distortion of this entity's message, Q'uo says. But there is enough in what is left of what he actually said to begin to form an idea of what it takes to form a social memory complex.

Look, for instance, at what the instrument calls the Beatitudes. It is interesting to note who is blessed. Blessed are the poor. Blessed are the meek. Blessed are the hungry. Blessed are those who suffer for righteousness' sake. Blessed is adversity. Blessed is the enemy. Blessed is he who despitefully uses you. In other words, Q'uo says, no matter what you do you will be blessed.

When this entity was on the cross dying painfully, a thief asked him if he would remember him when he came into his kingdom. And Jesus said to him, this day you will be with me in paradise. Jesus was not a foolish man. He did not feel that all things were good. He felt that some things were sinful. But he took it to a higher level in each and every case and said: the past is past. Make a new beginning, and you are completely and utterly forgiven.

Would that the voices that surrounded this entity had the same message, Q'uo says. Much has been lost of the message because others immediately misunderstood it, and during the time he was alive felt that he should become a political figure and rule a physical country. This Jesus rejected out of hand.

So if Jesus was offering information about the vibration of a social memory complex, then the direction that entities who wish to help form one need to go is the direction of forgiveness and love. Forgiveness of enemies. Forgiveness of the self. And the willingness to make a new beginning. These seem finite qualities, but in the metaphysical world they are infinite. The freedom to expand and strengthen light is complete once the soul has pierced the veil of forgetting.

Then Q'uo gives a tiny example of a social memory complex. A couple, or a family, which is extremely close, so that the entities have begun to tune into each other and eerily know what the other was going to say, how the mood of the other was, without having to speak. There is a growing awareness from the soul level when there is complete trust between two people. This is difficult to achieve. It takes time and persistence on the part of two human beings who will systematically fail at everything they try at one point or another, metaphysically speaking. And so there is forgiveness built into trust. When entities within a fellowship of complete trust misbehave, they are allowed the room to do that. They are allowed the support to come out of that. They are allowed the chance to start anew.

These qualities of forgiveness and forgetting and moving on are sweet indeed, Q'uo says, because they free up the energy system, the energy body. I love that: forgiveness as something sweet, something that literally frees the energy to move again.

And one more thread from that session, from the one known as T, who asked about fear and anger. Q'uo says that all overlays being taken away are improvements, and that no matter what the negatively oriented emotion, it is a type of fear. Whether it is anger, grief, jealousy or despair, underneath it lies fear. The fear now is exposed because of T's practice, and now he is able to see and be aware of what that underlying emotion truly is. That seeing is the improvement.

The freedom to begin again. The sweetness of forgiveness. The tiny social memory complex of two people who trust each other completely. That is the whole teaching, and it fits in a Christmas week.

Thank you for listening.

title: A Sonata Under Construction
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: A Sonata Under Construction.

The sixth of January, two thousand and two. The group decides to take pot luck and see what Q'uo might have to say. No prepared question. Just an open invitation. And Q'uo's answer is, to my ear, one of the loveliest in this whole stretch of the archive.

Left to ourselves, Q'uo says, we speak one tune. We tell one story. We tell of love. And yet even within this small a group of three they would be able to rest within each mind and discover the genius that lies in the connections between those minds, and find a completely unique subject at any time. For the energy between even any two people, much less any three, is a complex and multi-layered thing. Each of you is connected to each other by those things you are working on in common, by those services you share in common, by the desires that resonate between each of you in common.

Each of you, Q'uo says, has a voice, has an energy, has the potential to sing a certain beautiful and complex melody. But each of you, indeed, in the present moment is a sonata under construction, a musical piece that has not yet been finished. And so there is the rehearsal and the playing over of the tunes of self, those leitmotifs of being.

A sonata under construction. I keep turning that over. We are not failed symphonies. We are works in rehearsal, playing over our own themes, listening for how they want to resolve.

The one known as T had said he missed the opportunity the previous week to come together in seeking, and Q'uo addresses this with a point they say is valuable for all groups seeking to increase the light upon planet Earth. It is very well to establish a group. It is very well to begin a practice of spiritual seeking. When you come together as a group in a regular and persistent fashion, these threads begin to weave themselves without your conscious awareness into a far more coherent and lambent pattern, banked and steeped in light because of the energy of those companions of the path that have entered the silence together over a period of time.

Opening to the silence in a group over a twenty-year period, which these particular three entities have enjoyed together, is opening a very small social memory complex between the three seated in the circle. Plus the social memory complex existing between each pair in the group which have a close bonding. Plus the social memory complex that exists within fourth density, and within fifth, and within sixth, which forms the principle which is our voice.

I love how casually Q'uo reveals the architecture here. Three friends sitting in silence for twenty years have woven something real. A small social memory complex. Rather than bringing one entity into the silence, by meeting in a group over time you are weaving for yourself a solid and reliable resource which contains your energy spoken truly and reflected in the mirror of those who love you and those who would wish to help you.

Meeting in trust, coming together in humility and seeking, are energies which ennoble and strengthen that within you which seeks, Q'uo says, so that you may have the grace to continue to seek. For indeed, they do not advertise that there are easy answers. Indeed they do not advertise answers. They urge the questioning. They encourage the hunger.

And here not the intellectual hunger, though that has its place, but the deeper hunger, the desire to know the self and the Creator with the whole being. You choose not only the road you are on, Q'uo says, but the turnings from that road that are implied in the depths of your seeking, in the quality of your attention, and in the sincerity of your humility at asking and knowing that you know not, and truly wishing to know.

This desire is not a permanent or fixed thing in anyone, Q'uo says. It is a commitment revisited each day, or at least from time to time. The sonata keeps being rehearsed. The melody keeps being played over. And the rehearsal itself is the work.

Thank you for listening.

title: How Thought Shapes Reality
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: How Thought Shapes Reality.

The twentieth of January, two thousand and two. The question to Q'uo: do we create our experience, our reality, by the way we think, by the way we believe? And if so, how does that work?

Q'uo begins by saying the creation you experience and the reality of which that creation is the illusion are very, very close together, but are not the same thing. The illusion is as close as a heartbeat to reality, but is invested with physicality, so that you are a traveler in two worlds at the same time: the world of your outer experience and the world of your inner experience. To suggest that the inner experience influences the outer would not be unusual at all. It is clear to everyone how much difference a person's attitude can make. The glad smile, or the way of making light of some perceived difficulty, will always create an atmosphere that helps people, if not the self, feel better about a situation.

But then Q'uo goes deeper. Each of you, they say, is part of a group oversoul, a larger self that contains many seeming individuals that are not the self but in actuality are part of the self. And these larger entities are part of even larger entities, until you get to the level of planets and sun bodies, entities of many orders of magnitude beyond what you now experience.

And here is the honest turn. A great deal of the path of seeking the truth is discovering the depth of the truth that one cannot control all things in order for the self to feel comfortable. For the self will never feel comfortable. All things cannot be controlled, and most things are not even supposed to be controlled. The way the illusion is set up is almost guaranteed to make it impossible for you to control the inner universe. The outer personality shell attempts to order things so the self will be comfortable. That is the usual choice. But it is not the way things are made.

Q'uo then discusses a film the group had been watching, in which a scientist suggests that the role of the physical things that make up the body, the genetic structure, is not as controlling as it appears from the outside. The entity explained that the genetic structures have a garment, a sleeve, kept over them so that certain potentials do not become activated in the life experience as long as the covering remains. This covering is made of proteins. These proteins are excited by incoming signals. And the belief of the person has the actual physical power to change the input signal that electrifies the proteins.

I want to be careful here. This is the archive's discussion of an idea from a popular film, not a medical claim, and I am not presenting it as one. What interests me is the principle Q'uo draws from it. If there is a tendency toward illness in the family, by figuring out what keeps that sleeve on, so to speak, and what things to avoid so as not to take that sleeve off, that tendency never needs to be excited, never needs to be experienced. This, Q'uo says, is sound in terms of your own world's science, and sound in terms of what they believe to be so.

And here is the heart of it. What you think to yourself, what you say to those about you, has, to the extent that you believe what you are saying, a power over your future.

But Q'uo is careful, and I love the care. We are not suggesting that it is possible to look at a situation where a house is on fire and say that this is perfect. This will not stop the house from burning down. Thought concerning a seemingly unfortunate situation will not change the structure of that situation, at least not in the physical. Think instead about the last time you heard of someone who came through a fire. What were they saying? They were probably saying: thank God that my wife and children are safe. All we lost was the house.

Somehow it is the function of bad fortune not to create tragedy in people's lives, Q'uo says, but to open possibilities for thankfulness and for positive change. With the gift of hindsight one is able to look back on such passages through difficulty and pinpoint the real quality of that experience that seemed in the present moment to be a dreadful thing, but seen from the future looking backwards becomes almost the opposite: almost a boon, almost a point of fortune, because of the learnings and the maturity gained during the experience.

So when faced with something perceived as a difficulty, Q'uo is not suggesting you put on rose-colored glasses. What they encourage is a thoughtful approach willing to accept the two-natured quality of all apparent experience. There is an outer quality to the experience, what you are seeing and feeling and touching. And there is an inner quality, made up of the way you are at the moment on the surface, plus those deeper levels of the self where you have let some sunlight into deeper parts, where you are aware of some of your geographies of mood and emotion.

The illusion is as close as a heartbeat to reality. And what you think, to the extent you believe it, shapes the future that heartbeat moves toward.

Thank you for listening.

title: The Temple Made of Silence
transcript:
Voices from the Archive. Tonight: The Temple Made of Silence.

The fourth of February, two thousand and two. A Monday meditation. The question to Q'uo concerns self-doubt in relation to change, and to the increased vibrations that everyone seems to feel: more stress, more choices, more anxiety in the life pattern. How can we deal with self-doubt when stability is hard to find?

Q'uo begins by naming the position of the awakened seeker. Caught between two worlds. Not stranded, not snared, but aware of and needing to relate to worlds that seem very separate. Responding to the demands of physical incarnation, the need for supply, warmth, shelter, food, clothing, is not an easy or simple task. And at the same time there is within you a vertical life that seeks always to reach higher and to go deeper, to find the springs of inspiration within the roots of consciousness and the guidance from up above.

The particular energies of this time have an unusually strong and generous quality, Q'uo says, for the simple reason that your entire globe is in that area of time and space in which your Earth's fourth density is coming into birth. These pressures for change are affecting not only each of you in subtle ways but the nature of time and space and the nature of light itself. So is it any wonder that each of you senses that this is a time of change? That there is some urgency to expressing the truth of the self?

The one known as R spoke of sitting on the fence over decisions, and Q'uo finds this often the skillful thing to do. There is, as far as they know, no indication, spiritually speaking, that it is better to move quickly than to move slowly.

Then the image that gives this episode its title. When change comes, the instrument was attempting to fit her old desk's accoutrements into a new desk, and finding that many things do not fit. What shall she do with these bits and pieces of a workaday life that no longer have a niche? So it is within the inner self when there is a change. What shall be packed up and taken with the self, and what shall be left behind? What still fits in the drawers of self, and what must be abandoned?

These are far more challenging questions than how to arrange a new situation in the physical, Q'uo says. And there is far less support within the network of relationships for these inner changes. Many sympathize with the new job, the new house, the new relationship. But there is no true social pattern for inner change. Each of you can think back into your life and see again and again those times of loneliness and solitude when the outer life was tranquil and yet the inner life was full of tumult.

It is not that there is no balm for those heart-sore people moving through change, Q'uo says. For there is endless balm, endless compassion, endless assistance. The challenge is in becoming still enough to receive.

There is the need to make a full stop from time to time in the day, Q'uo says. A disengaging from the details, the morasses and tangles of effort, relationship and profit. How precious it is simply to be able to stop, to rest, and to knock at the door of your own heart, hoping, waiting for the moment when the key turns because the mind is finally silent and that door springs open into that holy place wherein the Creator awaits.

There is a timeless temple made of silence, Q'uo says, arched with beauty, steepled with hope, founded on simple faith that all is well. It is a spacious, spacious room, this holy of holies within. It is a wonderful slice of heaven, a small place of Eden where there is nothing rude, nothing imperfect, where there is never any change because all is truly one.

One key they share about change: refrain from thinking of it as a dialectic, for that simply perpetuates duality. Although yours is the density of choice, there is also a level wherein all is one. And each choice is far better served by preparatory time spent in the unitary and unified silence of your own heart, practicing the presence of the infinite Creator and allowing the questions in your heart simply to be, so that you and the Creator and the questions rest all together, loved and loving, Creator known to created, created known to Creator.

Each time you come into this space, move into it with empty hands, Q'uo says. For you know not what gifts the silence will bring you. You do not know what beasts, birds, winds and weathers may respond and come to bring you messages, giving eloquence to the silence and hints to the wise.

And when you do not have the chance to practice silence formally, seek the ways of nature and enter the creation of natural things whenever possible. For there in that world you are a harmonious and beloved part of all. Life and death are equally embraced, and all blooms and blossoms bow to the wind, to the weather, and to the seasons.
